opening.argument: The video is framed as a medical explanation of burning during urination, with the title asking, "What are the causes of burning sensation with urination?" [citation]. The consultant identifies dysuria and pain while passing urine, then explains that causes range from urinary tract infection to prostate malignancy [citation]. The speaker is visibly identified as Dr. Manohar T, Consultant Urology, Columbia Asia Hospitals, Whitefield [citation]. The hospital contact details are presented as ordinary healthcare-provider information, and the available evidence contains no request for investment, payment for a benefit, credentials, or participation in a suspicious scheme.
